title: Paradise Skydiving Oahu Tandem Skydiving

services.name: Tandem Skydives
services.desc: Our Accelerated Freefall (AFF) program is where first-time thrill turns into real skill - training you toward a USPA A License with experienced instructors guiding every jump. Our skydiving school progresses students through AFF categories A - D. For more information, refer to the USPA’s website. AFF training is held at the same location as our tandem skydiving jumps - the Skydiving Airport, 69-415 Farrington Hwy, Waialua, HI 96791. Pricing includes all rental equipment (parachute, goggles, jumpsuit, altimeter) and parachute packing for each jump. Depending on the package you choose, you can also receive professional photos, video footage, higher-altitude freefall, and a Paradise Skydiving T-shirt.
